title: Market Surf Report

conditions.headline: Beach Closed for Thanksgiving
conditions.summary: US stock markets are closed today for Thanksgiving. Trading resumes Friday with a shortened session that ends at noon Central.

sections.title: Futures & Overnight
items: US stock exchanges are closed for Thanksgiving, so there is no regular session today.
Holiday trading in futures and overseas markets is typically thin, so any moves today carry less signal than usual.

sections.title: Macro & Economic Calendar
items: No US economic releases are scheduled for the holiday.
Friday brings a shortened session, with stocks closing at noon Central.

sections.title: Earnings
items: No notable earnings are scheduled for the holiday.

sections.title: Stocks in the News
items: No pre-market session today; the lineup is empty until Friday.

sections.title: Business News
items: Black Friday kicks off the holiday shopping season, and retail sales headlines often drive Friday's half-day session.
Cyber Monday follows next week, putting online retailers in focus.

sections.title: What to Watch Today
items: Friday: stocks open at 8:30 AM CT and close early at 12:00 PM CT.
Early Black Friday shopping reports heading into Friday's short session.

script: Cowabunga! This is Surf Daddy, your local Kahuna, live from Surfside USA to all you Trade Wind surfers from the Gulf Coast to the North Shore. It's Thursday, November twenty-sixth, twenty twenty-six, and this is your Market Surf Report. Sitting next to me in a little pilgrim hat is my co-anchor, Gus the wonder dog. Happy Thanksgiving, Gus! Okay, here's the surf check. The beach is closed today, dudes. US stock markets are shut for Thanksgiving, so conditions are flat and glassy, with no swell at all. There's no regular session, no economic reports, and no big earnings on the calendar. Any holiday moves in futures or overseas tend to be thin, so don't read too much into them. The whole market caught a nice long wave this year, and that's worth being thankful for. That calls for a treat, Gus! Here you go, buddy, a little turkey! Now, the Dawn Patrol paddles back out tomorrow. Friday is a short session. Stocks open at eight thirty A M Central and close early at noon Central. Black Friday kicks off the holiday shopping season, so keep an eye on the early shopping reports. Retail headlines can make some waves in a quiet half day. Light volume can also make things a little gnarly, so no kook moves. Soul Surfers, this is a great day to step off the board, enjoy your family, and be stoked about the year. If you want to check a wave before tomorrow, type any stock, E T F or futures contract into the Check a Wave box on the page, and I'll call it for you. This is information, not advice. This is Surf Daddy and Gus the wonder dog saying, if in doubt, paddle out!
